name: NWO Talent Programme - Veni
other_rules: Any nationality, based in the Netherlands or abroad
PhD obtained within 3 years before 1 January of the call year (or during the call year up to the deadline), with extensions for personal circumstances
research at an NWO-recognised Dutch institution that supports your development
notes: 2026 deadline was 1 Sep 2026 (from a third-party listing; NWO page did not load). Part-time projects can run up to 4 years. Separate calls per domain (Science, ENW; Health, ZonMw; etc.).
